summary: A model call has no memory. You print exactly what a call sends (model, max_tokens, system prompt, messages) with a pretend server that needs no key, see that turn 2 re-sends the whole history, make one real call and read its response fields, and meet the errors from a missing key, a wrong key and a missing max_tokens.
goal: Read what a model call sends and receives: the system prompt, the messages, the history and the response fields.

items.text: Answer the two warm-up questions from memory, then guess the hook
Step 1: run show_request.py and find the system field and the messages, then compare turn 1 and turn 2
Step 2: run hello_llm.py with your key and match the shape of the fields
Step 3: change the system prompt and max_tokens, predict tokens out and the stop reason, then check
Step 4: trigger a missing key, a wrong key and a missing max_tokens, and read each error
Step 5: ask a follow-up with and without the history and compare the answers
Play the Message Inspector game to the end and see your score
